long_biography.plain_text:
Conor McGregor left a plumbing apprenticeship to pursue fighting, despite his parents’ doubts about making a living from it. He had begun exchanging boxing and jiu-jitsu techniques with Tom Egan before joining John Kavanagh’s Straight Blast Gym. His preparation included mentally rehearsing hand-wrapping, the introductions and the punches he expected to throw.

Proper No. Twelve Irish whiskey took its name from Dublin 12, where McGregor grew up. He worked with master distiller David Elder to choose a blend of grain and single-malt whiskey. Audie Attar and Ken Austin co-founded the business with him, launching it in 2018. Proximo Spirits acquired control in 2021.
long_biography.html:
Conor McGregor left a plumbing apprenticeship to pursue fighting, despite his parents’ doubts about making a living from it. He had begun exchanging boxing and jiu-jitsu techniques with Tom Egan before joining John Kavanagh’s Straight Blast Gym. His preparation included mentally rehearsing hand-wrapping, the introductions and the punches he expected to throw.

Proper No. Twelve Irish whiskey took its name from Dublin 12, where McGregor grew up. He worked with master distiller David Elder to choose a blend of grain and single-malt whiskey. Audie Attar and Ken Austin co-founded the business with him, launching it in 2018. Proximo Spirits acquired control in 2021.
